name: tuxinjector
author: bunny
description: [NOT legal to use in speedrun.com submissions or MCSR Ranked yet] Tux Injector is an overlay written in Rust that injects into Minecraft's rendering pipeline on Linux and macOS, similar to Toolscreen on Windows. The overlay can render resizable game-view mirrors, image overlays, captured app/windows, and - on Linux x86_64/aarch64 - live browser overlays.
